ai_language_tip: Indian English works for most city businesses; switch to Hindi (hi) in the north and with small shops if staff prefer, or the state language (Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Marathi, Bengali) in the south/east; Hinglish code-mixing is normal.
english_ok: yes — Widely used at hotels, private hospitals, chains and offices in cities; limited at small shops, mechanics and in smaller towns where Hindi or the state language is preferred.
politeness: Polite and friendly: greet with namaste or hello, use 'ji' and 'sir/madam'; requests are softened with 'please' and 'kindly'; thank with thank you or dhanyavaad.
name_tip: Name order and surnames vary by region (some South Indians use an initial instead of a surname); use Mr/Ms or 'ji' after the name; book under the name the person gives + mobile.
phone_tip: Mobile 10 digits starting 6–9 (98XXX 12345 style, read 5-5); landlines carry an STD code (Delhi 011-1234-5678); WhatsApp usually uses the same mobile.
time_tip: 12-hour with AM/PM dominates ('7:30 PM'); Hindi 'saadhe saat' = 7:30, 'paune aath' = 7:45, 'sawa saat' = 7:15; dates are day/month (25/11); 'IST' sometimes added.
number_tip: Large amounts use lakh (1,00,000) and crore; digits are read singly or in pairs ('double 9'); prices in rupees (Rs/₹).
avoid_calling: Avoid lunch 13:00–14:00, restaurant peaks 13:00–14:30 and 20:00–22:00 (dinner runs late), calls before 10:00 to shops, and major festival days (Diwali, Holi, Eid, Durga Puja, Pongal) that vary by state.
closed_days: Offices close Sunday (many also Saturday); markets in big cities have a weekly closed day that differs by market; many doctors do not see patients Sunday; state and religious holidays vary widely.
booking_channels: WhatsApp is the default for small businesses; District (Zomato) and Swiggy Dineout for tables; Practo and hospital apps for doctors; Swiggy/Zomato for delivery; Uber/Ola/Rapido for rides; Urban Company for home services.
voice_menu: Telcos (Jio, Airtel, Vi), banks, electricity boards and hospital call centres use IVR with English/Hindi/state-language options; small shops answer directly.
callback_habits: Businesses confirm by WhatsApp or SMS; platforms send SMS/app confirmations; clinics often call or WhatsApp the day before; delivery agents call on arrival.

activity.before_dialing_zh: 景點、遊樂園與活動多線上購票（District、BookMyShow）；小型導覽、健行與運動場可 WhatsApp 預約。

may_come_up.what: Tickets are sold on District or BookMyShow
Trek price includes transport from the city or not

sensitive_asked.what: Asks ID proof for permits or forest entry

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 髮廊、美容院與 spa 多電話或 WhatsApp 預約，婚禮季新娘妝要很早訂；居家美容常走 Urban Company。

may_come_up.what: Home salon services are booked through Urban Company
Bridal makeup needs an advance and a trial date

sensitive_asked.what: Asks full payment by UPI to a stylist's personal number

usually_asked: Service: haircut, facial, waxing, threading, bridal

change.before_dialing_zh: 改期或取消在原本的 WhatsApp 或電話處理；平台訂位與 Practo 預約可在 App 內改。

may_come_up.what: Practo appointment can be rescheduled in the app
Advance for a banquet booking may be adjusted, not refunded

sensitive_asked.what: Asks booking ID and OTP sent to the mobile

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 私立醫院與診所多電話、Practo 或醫院 App 預約，醫師有固定門診時段並常發號碼（token）；先問掛號費，週日多休診。

may_come_up.what: Practo shows the doctor's slots and consultation fee
Doctor gives tokens in order of arrival on the day

sensitive_asked.what: Asks Aadhaar or ABHA health ID number

usually_asked: Which doctor or department and OPD timing

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 電信（Jio、Airtel、Vi）、銀行與電力局客服有英語／印地語／邦語語音選單，帳戶事項須本人驗證。

may_come_up.what: Bank says account details only to the account holder

sensitive_asked.what: Asks Aadhaar, PAN, account number or OTP

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 行政手續多走各邦或中央政府網站預約再到場（如護照 Passport Seva）；學校入學詢問多電話或到校，週日不接。

may_come_up.what: Passport appointments are booked online at Passport Seva

sensitive_asked.what: Asks Aadhaar or birth certificate number of the child

usually_asked: Applicant or child's age and class

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 水電、冷氣與清潔多走 Urban Company 或電話叫；社區（society）門禁會要訪客或師傅登記，有的用 App 預先核准。

may_come_up.what: Urban Company shows a fixed price before booking
Society gate requires visitor approval for the technician

sensitive_asked.what: Asks UPI before the visit for a small repair

usually_asked: Service: AC service, RO water purifier, plumber, electrician
Flat number, tower, society name and landmark

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 飯店多經 MakeMyTrip、Booking.com、Agoda，小旅館常電話或 WhatsApp；入住須出示有照片的身分證件，外國旅客的資料飯店須在 24 小時內以 Form C 申報。

may_come_up.what: Photo ID needed for every adult guest at check-in
Foreign guests' passport and visa are recorded for Form C

sensitive_asked.what: Asks Aadhaar copy in advance on WhatsApp

usually_asked: Photo ID type of each guest

inquiry.before_dialing_zh: 詢問營業時間（timings）、排燈節與邦假日是否營業、可否用 UPI、有無停車位、是否有純素菜單。

may_come_up.what: Gives timings and festival closures
Confirms UPI and cards are accepted

pet.before_dialing_zh: 獸醫與寵物美容多電話或 WhatsApp 預約，大城市也有到府美容服務。

may_come_up.what: Home grooming charges by breed size
Vet asks to bring vaccination card

sensitive_asked.what: Pet boarding asks full UPI advance to a personal ID

usually_asked: Vet visit, vaccination, grooming or boarding

property.before_dialing_zh: 租屋多看 MagicBricks、99acres、NoBroker，仲介與房東習慣 WhatsApp 約看房；押金月數因城市差很多（班加羅爾常較高）。

may_come_up.what: Agent continues on WhatsApp
Security deposit months and brokerage fee

sensitive_asked.what: Asks token amount before a viewing

usually_asked: Family or bachelors, veg or non-veg household

repair.before_dialing_zh: 汽機車原廠保養可用品牌 App 或電話預約並可到府取車；小修理行多直接到場。

may_come_up.what: Dealer offers pick-up and drop for servicing
Local mechanic quotes after inspection

sensitive_asked.what: Asks RC (registration certificate) or insurance policy number

usually_asked: Car or two-wheeler model and registration number

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 印度城市餐廳可電話、WhatsApp 或 District、Swiggy Dineout 訂位；常問素食或非素食、是否需要耆那（Jain）餐，週末熱門時段平台折扣與訂位常不開放。

may_come_up.what: District or Dineout booking offers a bill discount paid through the app
Weekend slots not open for app booking; phone the restaurant
Cover charge for New Year's Eve or live-music nights

sensitive_asked.what: Asks UPI advance from the caller's own UPI ID

usually_asked: Smoking or non-smoking, indoor or rooftop

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 蛋糕、甜點（mithai）與排燈節禮盒常 WhatsApp 下單；蛋糕會問含蛋或無蛋（eggless），節日要提早並付 UPI 訂金。

may_come_up.what: Eggless cake option and advance by UPI

sensitive_asked.what: Asks advance to a UPI ID in another person's name

usually_asked: Weight in kg, flavour, eggless or with egg

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 小吃與餐廳可電話或 WhatsApp 點餐打包（parcel），外送以 Swiggy、Zomato 為主；常問素食、辣度與是否不放洋蔥大蒜。

may_come_up.what: Delivery only through Swiggy or Zomato
Pay by UPI QR at the counter

sensitive_asked.what: Asks UPI to a personal number before preparing a small parcel

usually_asked: Items and quantity (half or full plate)

tracking.before_dialing_zh: India Post、Delhivery、Blue Dart、DTDC 多為語音選單，建議用官網或 App 以追蹤號（AWB）查件。

may_come_up.what: Hotline gives status from the AWB number

transport.before_dialing_zh: 叫車以 Uber、Ola、Rapido 為主；機場接送與包車（outstation cab）可電話或 WhatsApp 預約，常按公里與天數計價。

may_come_up.what: Suggests Uber, Ola or Rapido for city trips
Outstation cab charges per km plus driver allowance and tolls

sensitive_asked.what: Self-drive rental asks driving licence and Aadhaar

usually_asked: Destination, airport terminal or outstation city
Passengers and luggage, sedan or SUV
